name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional rule — 'if you pick up the key, you must also open the door' — with a no-timing cue ('also'), so the single hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) is correct. 'Pick up the key' is the condition of an 'if', not a commanded goal, so no Existence clause is wanted. The machine has no FINAL_STATES and the rule-only warning is expected and valid for this task.

texts: If the agent ever picks up and holds the matching key, the door must also be opened at some point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
